info.name: GatherGo — Complete API (M1 + M2 + M4 + Prompt A + Migrations 005–008)
info.description:
Complete GatherGo collection — seeded test data pre-filled.

⚡ START HERE: Run folder 2 → "Login as Alice" — access_token auto-saves.
All UUIDs match the seed output.

Setup:
  1. node seed.js          (from backend/ directory)
  2. npm run dev
  3. Run "Login as Alice" below

Seed users (password: TestPass123!):
  alice   → test@gathergo.com     (primary test user)
  bob     → bob@gathergo.com      (accepted friend of alice)
  charlie → charlie@gathergo.com  (accepted friend of alice)
  diana   → diana@gathergo.com    (alice sent request → pending)
  eve     → eve@gathergo.com      (eve sent request to alice → alice can accept/decline)

Seeded trips:
  UPCOMING  b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001  Goa Trip 2027
  ONGOING   b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002  Manali Winter 2026
  PAST      b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003  Kerala Backwaters

Seeded expenses (Goa trip):
  c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001  Hotel ₹9000    equal split   alice paid
  c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002  Scuba ₹4000    percentage    bob paid
  c0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003  Dinner ₹3600   amount split  charlie paid

Seeded invite tokens:
  friend-invite-seed-token-001  (friend invite, created by alice)
  trip-invite-seed-token-001    (Goa trip invite, created by alice)

Migration 005: docs, photos, expenses, polls, and notes now use shared tables
with parent_type ('trip'|'event') + parent_id. All URLs are unchanged.

Migration 006: trips.banner_image_url (TEXT) — optional banner image for a trip.
Migration 007: trips.archived_at (TIMESTAMPTZ) — null = active, timestamp = archived.
  Archived trips are hidden from upcoming/ongoing/past lists.
  Use GET /trips?status=archived to retrieve them.
  Archive/unarchive via POST /trips/:id/archive and POST /trips/:id/unarchive (admin only).

Migration 008: note_favorites (note_id, user_id) — per-user note favorites.
  Toggle via POST /trips/:id/notes/:noteId/favorite → { isFavorited: bool }
  GET /notes returns isFavorited per note; favorited notes sorted to top.
